wifi.description: WiFi connection to Termux SSH server

usb.description: USB connection via ADB port forwarding

transfer.comment_chunk_size: 4MB is good for most connections. Use 1MB for slow/unreliable networks. Max 8MB.
transfer.comment_retry: Failed chunks automatically retried 3x with 1s delay between attempts
transfer.comment_workers: Number of concurrent workers per channel (USB and WiFi)
transfer.comment_verify: Verify SHA256 hash after transfer completes

channels.comment_channels: Both channels work simultaneously for maximum speed. Set to false to disable a channel.
channels.comment_preference: Scheduler automatically uses best channel. If both available, chunks distributed by speed.

performance.comment_progress: How often to update progress display (seconds)
performance.comment_health: How often to check channel health (seconds)

storage.comment_storage: Temporary chunk storage during receive operations

resume.comment_resume: Manifest files enable resume after interruption. Auto-cleanup after success.

logging.comment_logging: Set to DEBUG for verbose output, INFO for normal, WARNING for quiet

slow_network.comment: 1MB chunks for slow or unreliable WiFi

fast_network.comment: 8MB chunks for fast networks with good latency

usb_only.comment: USB transfer only (phone not on WiFi)
